metadata.article_title: Estoppel against denying original validity of instrument.

article.title: Estoppel against denying original validity of instrument.
article.content: No maker of a promissory note, and no drawer of a bill of exchange or cheque, and no acceptor of a bill of exchange for the honour of the drawer shall, in a suit thereon by a holder in due course, be permitted to deny the validity of the instrument as originally made or drawn.
article.html:
120Estoppel against denying original validity of instrument.

Section 120 · Chapter XIII · page 25 of the Act

No maker of a promissory note, and no drawer of a bill of exchange or cheque, and no acceptor of a bill of exchange for the honour of the drawer shall, in a suit thereon by a holder in due course, be permitted to deny the validity of the instrument as originally made or drawn.
